analysis_status: post-outcome referee-led numerical audit specified before V3 Gate-1 results

input_contract.receipt_authentication: fail unless the receipt binds this analysis ID and byte hash, the canonical ID and byte hash, all canonical source hashes, every lookup/bridge hash, the fixed-membership hash, the byte-locked builder and transitive code aggregate, exact authenticated SCC runtime, clean committed Git checkout and required ancestry, canonical six-field raw router, exact per-occupation assignment fingerprint, balanced grid counts, and a sanitized no-private-path command template
input_contract.support_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 of sorted zero-padded occupation codes, one code plus newline per record

likelihood.objective: sum_i young_i*eta_i - total_i*log(1+exp(eta_i)); implemented with logaddexp and multiplied by a positive numerical scale only
likelihood.probability_clipping: none in the two audit solvers or profile; inherited solver clipping is measured as a comparator
likelihood.sparse_cell_rule: no minimum young or older count; retain genuine one-sided cells
likelihood.zero_total_rule: zero likelihood and score contribution; retain in input/accounting and omit only from design fitting

boundary_and_separation.boundary_group_rule: iteratively profile out and record a nuisance FE group only when, on the remaining positive-total rows, its aggregate young stock is exactly zero or its aggregate older stock is exactly zero
boundary_and_separation.cell_boundary_rule: young==0 or older==0 exactly; no count threshold
boundary_and_separation.extended_face_rule: after pure nuisance boundary profiling, if the certified normalized recession LP finds separation, solve two direct minimum-infinity-norm LPs with each declared target fixed at +1 and -1; any certified cone-feasible unit-target direction, including a zero-gain likelihood-lineality direction, proves that target can diverge and blocks it; only when both signs are infeasible for the focal and every reported Q5 event target may certified strict-margin rows be profiled as a target-invariant extended-likelihood face, followed by cascading pure-nuisance profiling and repetition to a finite face
boundary_and_separation.linear_program: on the profiled core, interior rows impose Xd=0; all-young rows impose Xd>=0; all-older rows impose Xd<=0; coefficients are scaled to [-1,1] only to normalize the global recession-direction search; focal-direction LPs use an explicit infinity-norm epigraph and target=+1 or -1
boundary_and_separation.separation_classification: report complete versus quasi separation and counts of strict-margin and zero-margin boundary rows
boundary_and_separation.target_rule: a finite target is not established if it is rank unidentified, either direct signed-target LP is incomplete, or it can move in a remaining likelihood recession or lineality direction; for dynamics this applies to the observed-month-weighted post functional and every one of the 38 reported Q5 event coefficients; nuisance-only recession is resolved by exact face profiling rather than globally blocking
boundary_and_separation.treatment_rank_rule: if nonfocal treatment columns are dependent after face profiling but the focal coordinate is rank identified, use a pivoted-QR exact column-space basis that retains the focal original column; otherwise block

design_parity.comparison: exact regressor matrix equality, normalized semantic label equality, both FE partition equalities, and an independent SHA-256 design fingerprint for every one of the eleven core or preserved-failure models
design_parity.dynamics_transition_adjudication: the byte-locked submitted setup_historical implementation removes TRANSITION=2022-12; the audit therefore excludes 2022-12, notwithstanding the superseded draft spec text

hessian_diagnostics.fitted: full normalized nuisance-plus-treatment observed information at the exact L-BFGS-B fitted probabilities; require rank equal to every normalized design column and positive definiteness at the declared tolerance in both the raw and diagonal-scaled extreme spectra
hessian_diagnostics.geometric: full normalized nuisance-plus-treatment information at total/4 weights, raw and diagonal-scaled extreme spectrum
hessian_diagnostics.rank_accounting: full rank equals normalized nuisance rank plus Schur-complement treatment rank; report any deficiency

dynamic_target_scope.post_functional_weighting: equal weight per observed calendar month

normalization.rule: include every first-FE dummy and omit one lexicographically first second-FE dummy in each connected component of the positive-total bipartite FE graph
normalization.target_invariance: normalization changes nuisance coordinates only, not fitted means or treatment coefficients

output_safety.atomic_publish: write all artifacts to a private same-parent staging directory and atomically rename only after every artifact and the sanitized receipt is complete
output_safety.disjointness: output leaf must be outside the Git repository and disjoint from all input files
output_safety.failure_behavior: never overwrite a pre-existing target; preserve an unpublished staging leaf for diagnosis after an ordinary numerical failure, but discard it if final sanitation detects a private path or credential; every BLOCKED status exits nonzero and there is no report-only success override
output_safety.receipt_command: persist only a placeholder command template; resolved private paths and credentials are forbidden
output_safety.whole_artifact_sanitization: scan every staged output as UTF-8 text for private absolute paths, GitHub tokens, named password/API-key/secret assignments, private-key headers, and credential-bearing URLs before atomic publication

software.independent_solver_2: scipy.optimize.minimize trust-ncg with analytic score and Hessian-vector product

optimizer_options.L-BFGS-B: gtol is 0.001 times the declared scaled-gradient audit tolerance; ftol=1e-15; maxls=50; maxcor=20
optimizer_options.trust-ncg: gtol is 0.01 times the declared scaled-gradient audit tolerance

runtime_contract.kernel_policy: record compute-node kernel release but do not equality-lock its patch version
